newsitem.title: USA: Class action suit filed vs Mobile Telecomm.
newsitem.headline: Class action suit filed vs Mobile Telecomm.

text.p: Attorneys for purchasers of Mobile Telecommunication Technologies Corp common stock said Monday a class action lawsuit was commenced February 20 against the company, its officers and directors.

Plaintiffs allege the parties violated sections 10b and 20 (a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 "by disseminating false and misleading statements" about the demand for the company's SkyTel 2-way and 1-way paging services as well as the company's overall financial health, according to a statement released by Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach, one of the firms representing the plaintiffs.

The suit was filed on behalf of purchasers of common stock during the period January 19, 1995 to February 22, 1996. During this "class period," certain defendants sold between 83 percent and 100 percent of their Mobile Telecommunication stock at prices as high as 30-7/8 per share, according to the statement.
Plaintiffs seek to recover all damages on behalf of purchasers during the class period.
Mobile Telecommunication said in a statement it was "reviewing the allegations in the complaint and intends to vigorously defend in this litigation."
Mobile is headquartered in Jackson, Miss., and had 1995 revenues of $246 million.
